newsitem.title: BELGIUM: W.European airlines post 11.7 pct May traffic rise.
newsitem.headline: W.European airlines post 11.7 pct May traffic rise.

text.p: Major west European airlines posted an 11.7 percent year-on-year rise in passenger traffic for May, maintaining the year's buoyant trend, the Association of European Airlines (AEA) said in a statement on Wednesday.

"All regions showed growth, with the three largest, the North Atlantic, intra-European and Far East/Australasia, all recording increases in excess of 10 percent," said the AEA, whose 26 member airlines include the region's main flag carriers.
Airlines grew capacity by 6.5 percent, with the strong demand more than accounting for the extra seats offered in terms of improved airline load factors.

"The result has been record load factors for the time of year, not just marginal improvements but substantial increases. For all routes, the load factor of 70.6 percent compared with 67.4 percent in May 1996," it said.
International freight carried by AEA members also grew over the period, rising 4.9 percent overall.
